lines.speaker: Tilly
lines.text: Hi again! It is Tilly. Today I have a <color=red>dinosaur</color> story!

lines.speaker: Tilly
lines.text: Listen to my story. Then I will ask four <color=red>questions</color>. Get them right and the library gets four new books!

lines.speaker: Tilly
lines.text: Dot is a small green dinosaur. Dot has a long <color=red>tail</color>.

lines.speaker: Tilly
lines.text: One day, Dot finds a big white <color=red>egg</color> in the grass.

lines.speaker: Tilly
lines.text: Dot sits by the egg all night. Dot keeps it <color=red>warm</color>.

lines.speaker: Tilly
lines.text: In the morning, crack! A baby dinosaur pops out. Now Dot has a new <color=red>friend</color>.

lines.speaker: Tilly
lines.hint: Not quite. Think about the start of the story!

lines.speaker: Tilly
lines.text: Question 2: What does Dot find in the grass?
lines.hint: Not quite. It is big and white!
lines.correctText: That is right! Dot finds an egg.

lines.speaker: Tilly
lines.text: Question 3: Why does Dot sit by the egg?
lines.hint: Not quite. Dot sits there all night. Try again!
lines.correctText: Well done! Dot keeps the egg warm.

lines.speaker: Tilly
lines.text: Question 4: What comes out of the egg?
lines.hint: Not quite. Think about the end of the story!
lines.correctText: Yes! A baby dinosaur comes out.

lines.speaker: Tilly
lines.text: Four out of four! You are so <color=red>clever</color>. The library has four new books!

afterLines.speaker: Tilly
afterLines.text: I love dinosaur stories. Go and read the new <color=red>books</color> in the library!
